messages:
Priya K: Heads up — got ~8 alert emails from eval scorecard in the last 6 hours. Looks like the quantized variant (q4) is causing tiny metric jitter and the dashboard alert keeps firing :eyes:
Miguel R: Link? run id? able to check now.
Priya K: https://console.redwood.internal/scorecards/scorecard/1432?view=diff
Priya K: Alert rule (copied):
```
WHEN avg(metric.delta_score, 5m) > 0.07 FOR 2m
AND count(metric.samples) > 50
```
Lina S: Hmm that rule is pretty aggressive for low-signal cohorts. Quantized token-level noise can push avg a bit. I'd either increase window or require larger delta.
Theo C: Also saw the CI eval-runner re-run three times on the same commit around 03:12 UTC — retries uploaded duplicate samples, which the scorecard agg doesn't dedupe right now :face_with_head_bandage:
CI Bot: eval-runner #782 failed: flaky-agent retry (exit 124). Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/782/
Miguel R: If uploads were duplicated that will bump counts and change weighted averages. Can we check artifact manifests? I'm pulling s3 list now.
Ava M: I prototyped a quick dedupe patch in runner: added monotonic sample_id check before upload. snippet:
```
if seen_sample_ids.contains(sample.id):
    continue
upload(sample)
```
Ava M: Also added instrumentation to emit 'dedupe_skipped' metric.
Priya K: Nice. Two action items: (1) tweak alert to 15m window + 0.1 threshold to reduce noise; (2) merge runner dedupe patch and backfill deduped aggregates. Who can take (2)?
Theo C: I'll own the merge/backfill. Will coordinate with infra for S3 reprocessing job.
Miguel R: I'll update the alert rule in prod console and add a note on the scorecard explaining quant noise.
Priya K: Great. filing a follow-up ticket and linking this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
